title: Enterprise Steel, Cement & Process Metallurgy Ladle Alloy-Addition MILP, Refractory Wear & Kiln MPC Agent

tiers.tier: Tier 1: Manual Melter Aim-Midpoint Recipe + Fixed Ladle Relining Cycles
tiers.architecture: Operators dosing expensive ferroalloys (FeV, FeNb, FeMo) to the conservative middle of chemistry specs + pulling steel ladles on rigid 75-heat reline rules

tiers.tier: Tier 2: Prompt-Only General LLM Spectrometer & Kiln Operator Chatbot
tiers.architecture: Feeding OES spectrometer chemistry readouts into GPT-4o / Claude to calculate ferroalloy additions without multi-element impurity cross-coupling or slag oxidation recovery

tiers.tier: Tier 3: Unconstrained Black-Box Regression (No Chance-Constrained Lower Spec Bound)
tiers.architecture: Standard GBDT predicting alloy additions to target the minimum spec line with 50% mean probability (causing 4.9% heats to fall below minimum Mn/Cr/V spec)

tiers.tier: Tier 4: Chance-Constrained Alloy Blend MILP + 3D Laser/RJPEG Refractory Twin + Kiln Burning-Zone MPC Agent
tiers.architecture: 99.5% Chance-Constrained Ferroalloy Blend MILP (Slag FeO Recovery) + 3D LiDAR/16-Bit RJPEG Refractory Remaining-Brick Twin + Rotary-Kiln Free-Lime/NOx MPC

scenarios.scenario: Ladle Furnace (LF) Multi-Element Ferroalloy Addition Optimization (250-Ton HSLA Steel Heat)
scenarios.question: Spectrometer shows C=0.06%, Mn=1.18%, V=0.032% against target [Mn: 1.35–1.50%, V: 0.045–0.060%, C <= 0.08%, P <= 0.015%]; select optimal mix across High-Carbon FeMn, Silico-Manganese, and Ferrovanadium
scenarios.model_answer: Solve 99.5% chance-constrained linear program accounting for slag FeO oxidation recovery yield and trace carbon/phosphorus carried inside cheap HC-FeMn -> save $1,840/heat with 0.0% off-spec downgrade
scenarios.tier1_3_failure: Tier 1 doses pure expensive Low-Carbon FeMn to midpoint (+14.8% alloy waste); Tier 2 uses cheap HC-FeMn and pushes Carbon to 0.088% (>0.08% max), downgrading the entire 250-ton heat ($62K loss).

scenarios.scenario: Steel Ladle Slag-Line Refractory Brick Erosion & Molten-Steel Breakout Prevention
scenarios.question: Ladle #14 is at Heat 72; determine whether it can safely run 12 more heats or has a localized slag-line MgO-C brick washout risking a 1,620°C molten steel breakout
scenarios.model_answer: Fuse 3D laser profile scanner (remaining brick thickness mm) with 16-bit radiometric RJPEG shell thermal-conduction inverse model -> extend safe ladles to 88 heats while flagging localized <45mm hot-spot on Ladle #14
scenarios.tier1_3_failure: Tier 1 scraps every ladle lining at Heat 75 (wasting 22% usable refractory brick) while missing an early Heat-64 localized slag-line erosion.

scenarios.scenario: Cement Rotary-Kiln Burning-Zone Temperature (BZT) & Free-Lime (f-CaO) Clinker Quality MPC
scenarios.question: Stabilize a 5,000 tpd cement rotary kiln when alternative refuse-derived fuel (RDF) moisture fluctuates, causing burning-zone temperature and kiln drive torque to oscillate
scenarios.model_answer: Run nonlinear MPC over kiln main-drive amps, thermal NOx proxy, and XRD free-lime soft sensor; modulate coal/RDF feed and ID fan draft to hold f-CaO in [0.8%, 1.4%] (-10.3% fuel kcal/kg)
scenarios.tier1_3_failure: Tier 1 manual operator over-burns the kiln at 1,510°C 'just to be safe', wasting 11.5% coal/fuel and damaging kiln coating rings.

scenarios.scenario: Electric Arc Furnace (EAF) Scrap-Bucket Charge Mix & Tramp-Element (Cu / Sn) Dilution Gate
scenarios.question: Blend shredded auto scrap, busheling, and Direct Reduced Iron (DRI) for an automotive deep-drawing steel grade requiring Copper (Cu) <= 0.12%
scenarios.model_answer: Solve stochastic scrap-yard inventory MILP with tramp-element upper-tail CVaR_99 <= 0.115% Cu; increase DRI ratio by +6% before meltdown
scenarios.tier1_3_failure: Tier 1 charges cheap shredded scrap that melts in at 0.16% Cu (impossible to oxidize out of liquid steel), forcing a $48K grade downgrade.

perturbation_checks.perturbed: 0.0% Off-Spec Heat Downgrade | 1.3% Alloy Waste (Slag-FeO Conditioned Recovery Yield Active)

perturbation_checks.check: Alternative Fuel (RDF / Tire Chips) Calorific Value Drop (-18% kcal/kg) in Cement Precalciner
perturbation_checks.perturbed: 1.5% Kiln Fuel Overburn | 0.0% Clinker Off-Spec (Calciner Temp Feed-Forward Active)

key_findings: Tier 4 (99.5% Chance-Constrained Ferroalloy MILP + 3D LiDAR/RJPEG Refractory Twin + Rotary-Kiln MPC) slashes expensive ferroalloy overconsumption from 14.8% to 1.1% while achieving 0.0% off-spec heat downgrades.

Accounting for trace carbon/phosphorus impurities inside low-cost ferroalloys and conditioning recovery yields on slag FeO oxidation saves $1,840 per 250-ton steel heat without breaching upper impurity limits.

Coupling 3D laser refractory thickness scans with 16-bit radiometric shell thermography and rotary-kiln Free-Lime/NOx MPC cuts monthly alloy, kiln fuel, and heat-downgrade losses from $1.18M to $112K (-90.5%).
